summary: Fractal web shows an agent's canonical KDL declaration, with environment values redacted, in a modal opened from the conversation header or the agent row menu; a mission opens as a labelled, redacted structured definition because st serves no mission KDL.

replay.detail: Web-only change. No startup replay or history rewrite.

schema.detail: No table, index, stored format, API schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No claim vocabulary, admission, ordering, checkpoint or retention changes.

compatibility.detail: Reads the existing agent-declarations endpoint with show_env_values=false and the existing publication-definition read; both need read.declarations, and connections without it see a refusal message. No server change.

manual.detail: Normal web deploy; no operator step.

recovery.detail: Read-only view; a failed read shows an error and changes nothing.
